```{r preflight-inventory}
scale_check <- inventory |>
  dplyr::group_by(phenotype) |>
  dplyr::mutate(rel = unit_amp / unit_amp[arm == "Real"]) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::filter(arm != "Real", rel < 1 / 3 | rel > 3)
if (nrow(scale_check)) {
  stop("Unitary amplitude differs from the seed by more than 3x in: ",
       paste(sprintf("%s/%s (%.3g vs %.3g)", scale_check$phenotype,
                     scale_check$arm, scale_check$unit_amp,
                     scale_check$unit_amp / scale_check$rel), collapse = "; "),
       ". Likely scaling or units mismatch.")
}

nice_kable(inventory, digits = 4, label = "preflight_inventory",
             caption = "Pre-flight inventory of every record analysed.")
readr::write_csv(inventory, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "preflight_inventory.csv"))
```

## Sample rate

Only the seed record's time column reflects a real acquisition.
`diffusion_app.py` writes its export time as `arange(n) * d * SAMPLE_DT` with
`SAMPLE_DT` fixed at 1e-4, so a DDPM record always claims 10 kHz whatever it was
trained on. A GAN record's time column is whatever DeepGANnel wrote. Where it
disagrees with the seed:

- `rate_policy = "seed"`: the time column is ignored and the record takes the
  seed's rate.
- `rate_policy = "own"`: the record's own rate is used (half the bandwidth,
  events twice as long in time).

The lag-1 autocorrelation of the single-level noise, reported per arm below, is
computed per sample and does not depend on the rate label. An arm close to its
seed was produced at the seed's rate; one well below it was produced at a lower
rate.

```{r rate}
seed_fs <- inventory |>
  dplyr::filter(arm == "Real") |>
  dplyr::mutate(fs = dplyr::if_else(has_time, fs, CFG$sample_hz))
seed_fs <- setNames(seed_fs$fs, seed_fs$phenotype)

rates_under <- function(policy) {
  inventory |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      phenotype, arm,
      fs = if (identical(policy, "own")) {
        dplyr::if_else(has_time, fs, unname(seed_fs[phenotype]))
      } else {
        unname(seed_fs[phenotype])
      })
}

rate_map <- function(policy) {
  r <- rates_under(policy)
  split(setNames(r$fs, r$arm), r$phenotype)
}

disputed <- rates_under("own") |>
  dplyr::rename(fs_own = fs) |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::rename(rates_under("seed"), fs_seed = fs),
                   by = c("phenotype", "arm")) |>
  dplyr::filter(abs(fs_own - fs_seed) / fs_seed > 0.01)

nice_kable(rates_under("seed") |>
               tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = fs),
             digits = 1, label = "rate_policy_seed",
             caption = "Sample rate per arm under the seed policy (Hz).")
```

```{r rate-disputed}
if (nrow(disputed)) {
  nice_kable(disputed, digits = 1, label = "rate_policy_disputed",
               caption = "Arms whose sample rate differs between the seed and own policies.")
} else {
  cat("No arm's own time column disagrees with its seed; the two policies coincide.\n")
}

FS_MAIN <- rate_map(CFG$rate_policy)

# Opening direction per phenotype, from the real record's labels, applied to
# every arm.
POL_MAIN <- inventory |>
  dplyr::filter(arm == "Real") |>
  dplyr::transmute(phenotype, polarity = sign(unit_amp))
POL_MAIN <- setNames(POL_MAIN$polarity, POL_MAIN$phenotype)

if (!all(POL_MAIN %in% c(-1, 1))) {
  stop("No measurable unitary amplitude in real record: ",
       paste(names(POL_MAIN)[!(POL_MAIN %in% c(-1, 1))], collapse = ", "))
}
```


Decimation decorrelates adjacent samples, so a record at half the rate has a
lower lag-1 autocorrelation than its seed.

## Noise level and segment length for the spectral metrics

The noise metrics need contiguous samples at one conductance level. A quiet
channel has long closed periods; a record at Popen 0.99 has long open periods
and closures only a sample or two wide. The level is chosen per phenotype as
whichever every arm of that phenotype can support.

An open-level spectrum also has no gating transition inside a segment. It
includes open-channel noise on top of instrumentation noise, the same in all
arms.

Segment length is also set per phenotype; the three arms of a phenotype share
it. `"auto"` takes the largest power of two that gives every arm
`psd_n_seg_min` segments (Welch variance falls as 1/n_seg), and falls back
towards the floor when no length does.

```{r level-and-seg}
cap_at <- inventory |>
  dplyr::group_by(phenotype) |>
  dplyr::summarise(closed = min(longest_closed), open = min(longest_open),
                   .groups = "drop")

levels_used <- cap_at |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    level = if (identical(CFG$noise_level, "auto")) {
      dplyr::if_else(open > closed, "open", "closed")
    } else {
      CFG$noise_level
    },
    cap = dplyr::if_else(level == "open", open, closed))

if (any(levels_used$cap == 0)) {
  z <- levels_used |> dplyr::filter(cap == 0)
  stop("No usable ", paste(unique(z$level), collapse = "/"), " segments at all in: ",
       paste(z$phenotype, collapse = ", "),
       ".")
}

nice_kable(levels_used, digits = 0, label = "levels_used",
             caption = "Longest run every arm can supply at each level, the level used, and the segment-length ceiling (cap).")
```

```{r seg-length-table}
LEVEL_OF <- setNames(levels_used$level, levels_used$phenotype)
CAP_OF   <- setNames(levels_used$cap,   levels_used$phenotype)

# Run lengths at the chosen level, per arm, per phenotype.
lens_of <- purrr::imap(recs, function(arms, ph)
  lapply(arms, run_lengths_at, level = LEVEL_OF[[ph]]))

seg_counts_at <- function(lens, nperseg)
  vapply(lens, seg_count, integer(1), nperseg = nperseg)

# Minimum segment length: psd_seg_min, and longer than the ACF's maximum lag.
SEG_FLOOR <- as.integer(2^ceiling(log2(max(CFG$psd_seg_min, CFG$acf_lag_max + 1))))

pick_nperseg <- function(lens, cap) {
  hi <- 2^floor(log2(cap))
  if (hi < SEG_FLOOR) return(NA_integer_)
  for (nps in 2^(floor(log2(hi)):floor(log2(SEG_FLOOR)))) {
    if (min(seg_counts_at(lens, nps)) >= CFG$psd_n_seg_min) return(as.integer(nps))
  }
  SEG_FLOOR
}

if (identical(CFG$psd_seg, "auto")) {
  NPERSEG_OF <- vapply(names(recs),
                       function(ph) pick_nperseg(lens_of[[ph]], CAP_OF[[ph]]),
                       integer(1))
  starved <- names(NPERSEG_OF)[is.na(NPERSEG_OF)]
  if (length(starved)) {
    stop(paste(starved, collapse = ", "), ": no arm supports ", SEG_FLOOR,
         " contiguous samples at the chosen level (caps ",
         paste(CAP_OF[starved], collapse = ", "), ").")
  }
} else {
  nps <- as.integer(CFG$psd_seg)
  if (nps < CFG$psd_seg_min) {
    stop("CFG$psd_seg = ", nps, " is below CFG$psd_seg_min = ", CFG$psd_seg_min, ".")
  }
  if (nps <= CFG$acf_lag_max) {
    stop("CFG$psd_seg = ", nps, " is not longer than CFG$acf_lag_max = ",
         CFG$acf_lag_max, ".")
  }
  short <- names(CAP_OF)[CAP_OF < nps]
  if (length(short)) {
    stop("CFG$psd_seg = ", nps, " but ", paste(short, collapse = ", "),
         " supports only ", paste(CAP_OF[short], collapse = ", "),
         " samples at the chosen level.")
  }
  NPERSEG_OF <- setNames(rep(nps, length(recs)), names(recs))
}

seg_tbl <- purrr::imap_dfr(lens_of, function(lens, ph) {
  n <- seg_counts_at(lens, NPERSEG_OF[[ph]])
  tibble::tibble(
    phenotype = ph, level = LEVEL_OF[[ph]], cap = CAP_OF[[ph]],
    nperseg = NPERSEG_OF[[ph]],
    seg_ms  = 1000 * NPERSEG_OF[[ph]] / FS_MAIN[[ph]][["Real"]],
    res_hz  = FS_MAIN[[ph]][["Real"]] / NPERSEG_OF[[ph]],
    Real = unname(n["Real"]), Diffusion = unname(n["Diffusion"]),
    GAN = if ("GAN" %in% names(n)) unname(n["GAN"]) else NA_integer_,
    n_used = min(n))
})

nice_kable(seg_tbl, digits = 1, label = "seg_length",
             caption = paste("Segment length chosen per phenotype, and the",
                             "segments each arm can supply at it. n_used is",
                             "the minimum across arms; with equalise_noise,",
                             "GAN and Diffusion are held to their shared",
                             "minimum and Real uses all its segments."))
readr::write_csv(seg_tbl, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "psd_segments.csv"))

thin <- seg_tbl |> dplyr::filter(n_used < CFG$psd_n_seg_min)
if (nrow(thin)) {
  warning("Fewer than CFG$psd_n_seg_min = ", CFG$psd_n_seg_min,
          " segments per arm in: ",
          paste(sprintf("%s (%d)", thin$phenotype, thin$n_used), collapse = ", "),
          ". Spectra are noisy; flagged as psd_n_seg_ok in the provenance table.")
}

if (dplyr::n_distinct(levels_used$level) > 1 ||
    dplyr::n_distinct(NPERSEG_OF) > 1) {
  cat("Level and/or segment length differ between phenotypes; noise metrics\n",
      "are not comparable in absolute terms across phenotypes.\n", sep = "")
}
```
# Per-phenotype analysis

Each phenotype is reduced to a long table of metrics, plus the curves for the
pooled figures. `direction` records which way is better for each metric.

```{r analyse}
analyse_one <- function(row, arms_all, fs, level, nperseg) {
  ph <- row$phenotype

  real    <- arms_all$Real
  arms    <- arms_all[setdiff(names(arms_all), "Real")]
  has_gan <- "GAN" %in% names(arms)

  # Windows and MMD
  W <- list(Real = make_windows(real$current, CFG$seq_len, CFG$n_windows_mmd))
  for (a in names(arms)) W[[a]] <- make_windows(arms[[a]]$current, CFG$seq_len,
                                                CFG$n_windows_mmd)
  half <- floor(nrow(real) / 2)
  W_r1 <- make_windows(real$current[1:half], CFG$seq_len, CFG$n_windows_mmd)
  W_r2 <- make_windows(real$current[(half + 1):nrow(real)], CFG$seq_len, CFG$n_windows_mmd)
  W_wn <- make_windows(rnorm(nrow(real), mean(real$current), sd(real$current)),
                       CFG$seq_len, CFG$n_windows_mmd)

  # One bandwidth for every comparison within the phenotype.
  gam <- median_gamma(W$Real, W$Diffusion)

  # Single-level noise
  # Runs kept separate; every record was checked earlier to hold at least one
  # segment.
  runs <- lapply(arms_all, level_runs, level = level, min_len = nperseg)

  # An arm that gates more often has shorter runs and fewer segments, so
  # simulated arms are held to the segment/sample counts of the thinnest.
  lens       <- lapply(runs, function(x) vapply(x, length, integer(1)))
  seg_avail  <- vapply(lens, seg_count, integer(1), nperseg = nperseg)
  samp_avail <- vapply(lens, function(L) sum(L[L > CFG$acf_lag_max]), integer(1))

  # GAN and Diffusion share a common cap; Real is the reference and is not
  # capped.
  sim_arm_names <- setdiff(names(arms_all), "Real")
  seg_cap_sim  <- if (isTRUE(CFG$equalise_noise)) min(seg_avail[sim_arm_names])  else Inf
  samp_cap_sim <- if (isTRUE(CFG$equalise_noise)) min(samp_avail[sim_arm_names]) else Inf
  seg_cap  <- setNames(ifelse(names(seg_avail)  == "Real", Inf, seg_cap_sim),  names(seg_avail))
  samp_cap <- setNames(ifelse(names(samp_avail) == "Real", Inf, samp_cap_sim), names(samp_avail))

  psd <- purrr::imap_dfr(runs, function(x, a)
    dplyr::mutate(welch_psd(x, fs[[a]], nperseg, seg_cap[[a]]), source = a))
  acf_tbl <- purrr::imap_dfr(runs, function(x, a)
    dplyr::mutate(acf_of(x, CFG$acf_lag_max, fs[[a]], samp_cap[[a]]), source = a))

  # Lag-1 autocorrelation of the single-level noise, per arm. A record at a
  # lower rate than assumed sits well below its seed.
  lag1 <- acf_tbl |> dplyr::filter(lag_n == 2)
  lag1 <- setNames(lag1$acf, lag1$source)

  # Arms at different rates have different frequency and lag grids, so both
  # comparisons interpolate onto a shared axis (a no-op when the grids match).
  curve <- function(tbl, a, xvar, yvar) {
    d <- tbl[tbl$source == a, ]
    list(x = d[[xvar]], y = d[[yvar]])
  }

  psd_rms <- function(a) {
    r <- curve(psd, "Real", "freq", "psd")
    g <- curve(psd, a, "freq", "psd")
    hi <- min(CFG$filter_hz, max(r$x), max(g$x))
    lo <- max(min(r$x), min(g$x))
    grid <- exp(seq(log(lo), log(hi), length.out = 512))
    # rule = 2: the log/exp round trip can put the grid ends ~1 ulp outside the
    # data range, where approx() would return NA.
    rms_diff(approx(r$x, log10(r$y), grid, rule = 2)$y,
             approx(g$x, log10(g$y), grid, rule = 2)$y)
  }

  acf_rms <- function(a) {
    r <- curve(acf_tbl, "Real", "lag_ms", "acf")
    g <- curve(acf_tbl, a, "lag_ms", "acf")
    grid <- seq(0, min(max(r$x), max(g$x)), length.out = CFG$acf_lag_max + 1)
    rms_diff(approx(r$x, r$y, grid, rule = 2)$y, approx(g$x, g$y, grid, rule = 2)$y)
  }

  # Slow envelope
  env <- list(Real = block_mean(real$current, CFG$slow_factor))
  for (a in names(arms)) env[[a]] <- block_mean(arms[[a]]$current, CFG$slow_factor)
  We <- lapply(env, function(e) make_windows(e, min(64, length(e)), CFG$n_windows_mmd))

  # Dwell times
  dw <- purrr::imap_dfr(arms_all, function(d, a)
    dplyr::mutate(dwell_times(d$channels, fs[[a]]), source = a))
  mean_dwell <- function(a, s) {
    v <- dw |> dplyr::filter(source == a, state == s) |> dplyr::pull(dwell_ms)
    if (!length(v)) stop(ph, "/", a, ": no ", s, " dwells to average")
    mean(v)
  }

  level_pts <- function(d) d$current[at_level(d, level)]

  # Assemble
  # One metric name whatever the level, so the pooled comparison keeps all
  # phenotypes; the level itself is recorded in the provenance table.
  sd_name <- "Noise SD (pA)"
  M <- function(metric, method, direction, value)
    tibble::tibble(phenotype = ph, metric = metric, method = method,
                   direction = direction, value = as.numeric(value))

  # Per-test equivalence detail (Delta, upper bound, n, verdict). Kept out of
  # `rows`; filled only from values already computed (no extra random draws).
  eqd <- list()
  EQ <- function(test, arm, delta, eq = NULL, note = NA_character_) {
    eqd[[length(eqd) + 1]] <<- tibble::tibble(
      phenotype = ph, test = test, arm = arm, delta = as.numeric(delta),
      upper = if (is.null(eq$upper)) NA_real_ else eq$upper,
      p     = if (is.null(eq$p))     NA_real_ else eq$p,
      n_real = if (is.null(eq$n_real)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(eq$n_real),
      n_arm  = if (is.null(eq$n_arm))  NA_real_ else as.numeric(eq$n_arm),
      equivalent = if (is.null(eq$equivalent)) NA else eq$equivalent,
      note = note)
  }

  message("  [", ph, " 1/6] amplitude window equivalence (real floor)...")
  amp_delta <- amplitude_floor_windows(real$current)

  # Parametric amplitude equivalence (two-Gaussian fit, fit_two_gaussian_em).
  # Mode is set once per phenotype from the real point estimate: if real does
  # not separate into two Gaussians, every fit for the phenotype uses the
  # single-Beta fit (fit_beta_single). Real bootstrap fits are shared across
  # arms and parameters.
  param_polarity <- POL_MAIN[[ph]]
  param_mode <- if (fit_two_gaussian_em(real$current, param_polarity)$ok) "gaussian" else "beta"
  param_beta_range <- if (param_mode == "beta") {
    pad <- 0.01 * diff(range(real$current))
    range(real$current) + c(-pad, pad)
  } else NULL
  if (param_mode == "beta") {
    message(ph, ": two-Gaussian EM did not separate on real; ",
            "using the single-component Beta fit (location/spread only).")
  }
  message("  [", ph, " 2/6] parametric TOST (real floor fits, mode=", param_mode, ")...")
  param_floor  <- param_floor_fits(real$current, real$channels, param_polarity,
                                    param_mode, param_beta_range)
  # Gaussian-mode sd and weight are tested by the noise-SD and Popen
  # distribution tests below. Beta mode has neither.
  PARAM_LABELS <- if (param_mode == "gaussian") {
    c(baseline = "Baseline (pA)", amplitude = "Unitary amplitude (pA)")
  } else {
    c(location = "Location (Beta fit, pA)", spread = "Spread (Beta fit, pA)")
  }
  # Gaussian mode: baseline/amplitude Delta is anchored to real's noise SD
  # (noise_sd_delta_for_param). Beta mode: location/spread use the bootstrap
  # Delta.
  param_delta <- setNames(
    lapply(names(PARAM_LABELS), function(f) {
      if (param_mode == "gaussian") {
        noise_sd_delta_for_param(f, real$current, real$channels)
      } else {
        param_delta_field(param_floor, f)
      }
    }),
    names(PARAM_LABELS))

  # Baseline/amplitude read from the channels column
  # (channels_baseline_amplitude); runs for either param_mode. Same noise-SD
  # Delta as the Gaussian-mode fit (noise_sd_delta_for_param).
  CHAN_AMP_FIELDS <- c(baseline = "Baseline (from channels, pA)",
                       amplitude = "Unitary amplitude (from channels, pA)")
  chan_amp_delta <- setNames(
    lapply(names(CHAN_AMP_FIELDS), function(f)
      noise_sd_delta_for_param(f, real$current, real$channels)),
    names(CHAN_AMP_FIELDS))
  message("  [", ph, " 3/6] channels-direct amplitude equivalence (real reps)...")
  chan_amp_real_pt   <- channels_baseline_amplitude(real$current, real$channels)
  chan_amp_real_reps <- channels_amp_real_reps(real$current, real$channels)

  # Same baseline/amplitude as a percentage of real's amplitude
  # (channels_amp_relative_delta).
  CHAN_AMP_REL_FIELDS <- c(baseline = "Baseline (relative, %)",
                           amplitude = "Unitary amplitude (relative, %)")
  chan_amp_rel_delta <- if (chan_amp_real_pt$ok) {
    setNames(
      lapply(names(CHAN_AMP_REL_FIELDS), function(f)
        channels_amp_relative_delta(f, real$current, real$channels,
                                     chan_amp_real_pt$amplitude)),
      names(CHAN_AMP_REL_FIELDS))
  } else {
    setNames(lapply(names(CHAN_AMP_REL_FIELDS), function(f) list(ok = FALSE, n = 0)),
             names(CHAN_AMP_REL_FIELDS))
  }

  # Noise-SD distribution equivalence per qualifying open/closed event
  # (noise_sd_by_event), one-sided (Wellek 2010). Runs for either param_mode.
  message("  [", ph, " 4/6] noise-SD distribution equivalence (per-event, real floor)...")
  NOISE_SD_STATES <- c("Open", "Closed")
  noise_sd_real_by_state <- setNames(
    lapply(NOISE_SD_STATES, function(s) noise_sd_by_event(real$current, real$channels, s)),
    NOISE_SD_STATES)
  noise_sd_delta_by_state <- setNames(
    lapply(noise_sd_real_by_state, dwell_delta),
    NOISE_SD_STATES)

  # Popen distribution equivalence per CFG$amp_win-sample window, one-sided
  # (Wellek 2010); see popen_delta/popen_equiv.
  message("  [", ph, " 5/6] Popen distribution equivalence (windowed, real floor)...")
  popen_delta_val <- popen_delta(real$channels)

  # Dwell-time distribution equivalence, one-sided, on the full open/closed
  # dwell-time distributions (dwell_delta/dwell_equiv).
  message("  [", ph, " 6/6] dwell-time distribution equivalence (real floor)...")
  DWELL_STATES  <- c("Open", "Closed")
  dwell_delta_by_state <- setNames(
    lapply(DWELL_STATES, function(s)
      dwell_delta(dw$dwell_ms[dw$source == "Real" & dw$state == s])),
    DWELL_STATES)

  rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    M("MMD vs real",          "Real floor",  "reference", mmd_rbf(W_r1, W_r2, gamma = gam)),
    M("MMD vs real",          "White noise", "reference", mmd_rbf(W$Real, W_wn, gamma = gam)),
    M("Amplitude equiv margin (Delta)", "Real (window floor)", "reference", amp_delta),
    M(sd_name,                "Real",        "reference", sd(level_pts(real))),
    M("Envelope SD (pA)",     "Real",        "reference", sd(env$Real)),
    M("Open probability",     "Real",        "reference", mean(real$channels > 0)),
    M("Mean open dwell (ms)", "Real",        "reference", mean_dwell("Real", "Open")),
    M("Mean closed dwell (ms)", "Real",      "reference", mean_dwell("Real", "Closed")),
    purrr::imap_dfr(PARAM_LABELS, function(label, f) {
      d <- param_delta[[f]]
      if (!d$ok) {
        fit_desc <- if (param_mode == "gaussian") "two-Gaussian" else "single-Beta"
        message(ph, ": '", label, "' ", fit_desc, " floor fit failed in too many ",
                "real block-bootstrap replicates (", d$n, "/",
                CFG$param_equiv_boot, " ok); Delta/TOST skipped.")
        return(M(paste0(label, " equiv margin (Delta)"), "skip", "reference", 0)[0, ])
      }
      M(paste0(label, " equiv margin (Delta)"), "Real (block-bootstrap fit)",
        "reference", d$delta)
    }),
    purrr::imap_dfr(CHAN_AMP_FIELDS, function(label, f) {
      d <- chan_amp_delta[[f]]
      if (!d$ok) {
        message(ph, ": '", label, "' has too few qualifying real events (", d$n,
                ") for a noise-SD Delta; skipped.")
        return(M(paste0(label, " equiv margin (Delta)"), "skip", "reference", 0)[0, ])
      }
      M(paste0(label, " equiv margin (Delta)"), "Real (noise SD)", "reference", d$delta)
    }),
    purrr::imap_dfr(CHAN_AMP_REL_FIELDS, function(label, f) {
      d <- chan_amp_rel_delta[[f]]
      if (!d$ok) {
        message(ph, ": '", label, "' has too few qualifying real events or a ",
                "zero/non-finite real amplitude; skipped.")
        return(M(paste0(label, " equiv margin (Delta)"), "skip", "reference", 0)[0, ])
      }
      M(paste0(label, " equiv margin (Delta)"), "Real (noise SD / amplitude)",
        "reference", 100 * d$delta)
    }),
    purrr::imap_dfr(dwell_delta_by_state, function(d, s) {
      if (!d$ok) {
        message(ph, ": too few Real ", s, " dwells (", d$n, ") for a dwell-time ",
                "equivalence floor; skipped.")
        return(M(paste0(s, " dwell equiv margin (Delta, ms)"), "skip", "reference", 0)[0, ])
      }
      M(paste0(s, " dwell equiv margin (Delta, ms)"), "Real (split-half)",
        "reference", d$delta)
    }),
    purrr::imap_dfr(noise_sd_delta_by_state, function(d, s) {
      if (!d$ok) {
        message(ph, ": too few qualifying Real ", s, " events (", d$n,
                ", need CFG$event_min_len = ", CFG$event_min_len, "+ samples) for a ",
                "noise-SD equivalence floor; skipped.")
        return(M(paste0(s, " noise SD equiv margin (Delta, pA)"), "skip", "reference", 0)[0, ])
      }
      M(paste0(s, " noise SD equiv margin (Delta, pA)"), "Real (split-half by event)",
        "reference", d$delta)
    }),
    if (!popen_delta_val$ok) {
      message(ph, ": too few real windows (", popen_delta_val$n, ") for a Popen ",
              "equivalence floor; skipped.")
      M("Popen equiv margin (Delta)", "skip", "reference", 0)[0, ]
    } else {
      M("Popen equiv margin (Delta)", "Real (window floor)", "reference", popen_delta_val$delta)
    },
    purrr::map_dfr(names(arms), function(a) {
      message("  [", ph, " arm:", a, "] MMD + parametric TOST fits...")
      pm <- mmd_permutation_p(W$Real, W[[a]], gamma = gam)
      param_fa    <- param_arm_fits(arms[[a]]$current, real$channels, param_polarity,
                                     param_mode, param_beta_range)
      fit_real_pt <- fit_amp_component(real$current, param_polarity, param_mode, param_beta_range)
      fit_arm_pt  <- fit_amp_component(arms[[a]]$current, param_polarity, param_mode, param_beta_range)
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        M("MMD vs real",            a, "lower",  mmd_rbf(W$Real, W[[a]], gamma = gam)),
        M("MMD permutation p",      a, "higher", pm$p),
        M("KS amplitude",           a, "lower",
          unname(ks_safe(real$current, arms[[a]]$current)$statistic)),
        {
          eq <- amplitude_equiv_windows(real$current, arms[[a]]$current, amp_delta)
          EQ("Amplitude", a, amp_delta,
             c(eq, list(n_real = CFG$n_windows_amp, n_arm = CFG$n_windows_amp)))
          dplyr::bind_rows(
            M("Amplitude equiv D upper", a, "lower", eq$upper),
            M("Amplitude equiv p",       a, "lower", eq$p)
          )
        },
        purrr::imap_dfr(PARAM_LABELS, function(label, f) {
          d <- param_delta[[f]]
          if (!d$ok) return(M(paste0(label, " TOST p"), a, "lower", 0)[0, ])
          eq <- param_equiv_field(param_floor, param_fa, f, d$delta)
          if (!eq$ok || !fit_real_pt$ok || !fit_arm_pt$ok) {
            fit_desc <- if (param_mode == "gaussian") "two-Gaussian" else "single-Beta"
            message(ph, "/", a, ": '", label, "' ", fit_desc, " fit unreliable ",
                     "(arm-side ok in ", eq$n_ok, "/", CFG$param_equiv_boot,
                     " replicates); TOST skipped.")
            return(M(paste0(label, " TOST p"), a, "lower", 0)[0, ])
          }
          dplyr::bind_rows(
            M(paste0(label, " equiv diff (point est.)"), a, "lower",
              abs(fit_real_pt[[f]] - fit_arm_pt[[f]])),
            M(paste0(label, " TOST p"), a, "lower", eq$p)
          )
        }),
        {
          chan_amp_arm_pt   <- channels_baseline_amplitude(arms[[a]]$current, arms[[a]]$channels)
          chan_amp_arm_reps <- channels_amp_arm_reps(arms[[a]]$current, arms[[a]]$channels,
                                                      real$channels)
          purrr::imap_dfr(CHAN_AMP_FIELDS, function(label, f) {
            d <- chan_amp_delta[[f]]
            if (!d$ok) return(M(paste0(label, " TOST p"), a, "lower", 0)[0, ])
            if (!chan_amp_real_pt$ok || !chan_amp_arm_pt$ok) {
              message(ph, "/", a, ": '", label, "' has no closed- or open-labelled ",
                       "samples on one side (real ok=", chan_amp_real_pt$ok, ", ", a,
                       " ok=", chan_amp_arm_pt$ok, "); skipped.")
              return(M(paste0(label, " TOST p"), a, "lower", 0)[0, ])
            }
            eq <- channels_amp_equiv(chan_amp_real_reps, chan_amp_arm_reps, f, d$delta)
            if (!eq$ok) {
              message(ph, "/", a, ": '", label, "' (from channels): too few usable ",
                       "block-bootstrap replicates (", eq$n_ok, "/",
                       CFG$param_equiv_boot, "); TOST skipped.")
              return(M(paste0(label, " TOST p"), a, "lower", 0)[0, ])
            }
            dplyr::bind_rows(
              M(paste0(label, " equiv diff (point est.)"), a, "lower",
                abs(chan_amp_real_pt[[f]] - chan_amp_arm_pt[[f]])),
              M(paste0(label, " TOST p"), a, "lower", eq$p)
            )
          })
        },
        {
          purrr::imap_dfr(CHAN_AMP_REL_FIELDS, function(label, f) {
            d <- chan_amp_rel_delta[[f]]
            if (!d$ok) return(M(paste0(label, " TOST p"), a, "lower", 0)[0, ])
            if (!chan_amp_real_pt$ok || !chan_amp_arm_pt$ok) {
              return(M(paste0(label, " TOST p"), a, "lower", 0)[0, ])
            }
            eq <- channels_amp_relative_equiv(chan_amp_real_reps, chan_amp_arm_reps, f,
                                               d$delta, chan_amp_real_pt$amplitude)
            if (!eq$ok) {
              message(ph, "/", a, ": '", label, "' had too few usable relative-diff ",
                       "replicates (", eq$n_ok, "/", CFG$param_equiv_boot,
                       "; fit-fail=", eq$n_discarded_fitfail, ", amplitude-guard=",
                       eq$n_discarded_guard, "); TOST skipped.")
              return(M(paste0(label, " TOST p"), a, "lower", 0)[0, ])
            }
            dplyr::bind_rows(
              M(paste0(label, " equiv diff (point est., %)"), a, "lower",
                100 * abs((chan_amp_real_pt[[f]] - chan_amp_arm_pt[[f]]) /
                          chan_amp_real_pt$amplitude)),
              M(paste0(label, " TOST p"), a, "lower", eq$p)
            )
          })
        },
        purrr::imap_dfr(dwell_delta_by_state, function(d, s) {
          if (!d$ok) {
            EQ(paste(s, "dwell"), a, NA, note = "skipped: too few real dwells for a margin")
            return(M(paste0(s, " dwell equiv p"), a, "lower", 0)[0, ])
          }
          arm_dwell <- dw$dwell_ms[dw$source == a & dw$state == s]
          eq <- dwell_equiv(dw$dwell_ms[dw$source == "Real" & dw$state == s],
                             arm_dwell, d$delta)
          EQ(paste(s, "dwell"), a, d$delta, eq,
             if (!eq$ok) paste0("skipped: ", length(arm_dwell), " arm dwells") else NA)
          if (!eq$ok) {
            message(ph, "/", a, ": too few ", s, " dwells (", length(arm_dwell),
                    ") for a dwell-time equivalence test; skipped.")
            return(M(paste0(s, " dwell equiv p"), a, "lower", 0)[0, ])
          }
          M(paste0(s, " dwell equiv p"), a, "lower", eq$p)
        }),
        purrr::imap_dfr(noise_sd_delta_by_state, function(d, s) {
          if (!d$ok) {
            EQ(paste(s, "noise SD"), a, NA,
               eq = list(n_real = length(noise_sd_real_by_state[[s]])),
               note = "skipped: too few qualifying real events for a margin")
            return(M(paste0(s, " noise SD equiv p"), a, "lower", 0)[0, ])
          }
          arm_sd <- noise_sd_by_event(arms[[a]]$current, arms[[a]]$channels, s)
          eq <- dwell_equiv(noise_sd_real_by_state[[s]], arm_sd, d$delta)
          EQ(paste(s, "noise SD"), a, d$delta, eq,
             if (!eq$ok) paste0("skipped: ", length(arm_sd), " qualifying arm events") else NA)
          if (!eq$ok) {
            message(ph, "/", a, ": too few qualifying ", s, " events (", length(arm_sd),
                    ") for a noise-SD equivalence test; skipped.")
            return(M(paste0(s, " noise SD equiv p"), a, "lower", 0)[0, ])
          }
          M(paste0(s, " noise SD equiv p"), a, "lower", eq$p)
        }),
        if (!popen_delta_val$ok) {
          M("Popen equiv p", a, "lower", 0)[0, ]
        } else {
          eq <- popen_equiv(real$channels, arms[[a]]$channels, popen_delta_val$delta)
          EQ("Popen", a, popen_delta_val$delta, eq,
             if (!eq$ok) paste0("skipped: ", eq$n, " arm windows") else NA)
          if (!eq$ok) {
            message(ph, "/", a, ": too few ", a, " windows (", eq$n,
                    ") for a Popen equivalence test; skipped.")
            M("Popen equiv p", a, "lower", 0)[0, ]
          } else {
            M("Popen equiv p", a, "lower", eq$p)
          }
        },
        M("log10 PSD RMS",          a, "lower",  psd_rms(a)),
        M("ACF RMS",                a, "lower",  acf_rms(a)),
        M("MMD envelope",           a, "lower",  mmd_rbf(We$Real, We[[a]])),
        M(sd_name,                  a, "match_real", sd(level_pts(arms[[a]]))),
        M("Envelope SD (pA)",       a, "match_real", sd(env[[a]])),
        M("Open probability",       a, "match_real", mean(arms[[a]]$channels > 0)),
        M("Mean open dwell (ms)",   a, "match_real", mean_dwell(a, "Open")),
        M("Mean closed dwell (ms)", a, "match_real", mean_dwell(a, "Closed"))
      )
    })
  )

  # Curves and provenance
  # time_ms is built from the sample index and the arm's assigned rate. The
  # DDPM export's own time column is a fixed 1e-4 s step.
  traces <- purrr::imap_dfr(arms_all, function(d, a) {
    n <- min(nrow(d), round(CFG$trace_secs * fs[[a]]))
    s <- best_window(d$channels, n)
    d[s:(s + n - 1), ] |>
      dplyr::mutate(source = a, phenotype = ph,
                    time_ms = 1000 * (dplyr::row_number() - 1) / fs[[a]],
                    win_start = s, win_popen = mean(channels > 0))
  })

  amp <- purrr::imap_dfr(arms_all, function(d, a)
    tibble::tibble(current = d$current, source = a, phenotype = ph))

  info <- tibble::tibble(
    phenotype = ph,
    seed_file = basename(row$raw),
    gan_file  = if (has_gan) basename(row$gan) else "none",
    ddpm_file = basename(row$ddpm),
    n_real = nrow(real),
    n_ddpm = nrow(arms$Diffusion),
    n_gan  = if (has_gan) nrow(arms$GAN) else NA_integer_,
    popen_real = mean(real$channels > 0),
    max_level_real = max(real$channels),
    fs_real = fs[["Real"]],
    fs_ddpm = fs[["Diffusion"]],
    fs_gan  = if (has_gan) fs[["GAN"]] else NA_real_,
    noise_level = level,
    psd_nperseg = nperseg,
    psd_seg_ms = 1000 * nperseg / fs[["Real"]],
    # Segments each arm could supply, then the count used. Indexed by name.
    psd_n_seg_real = unname(seg_avail["Real"]),
    psd_n_seg_ddpm = unname(seg_avail["Diffusion"]),
    psd_n_seg_gan  = if (has_gan) unname(seg_avail["GAN"]) else NA_integer_,
    psd_n_seg_used = psd$n_seg[psd$source == "Real"][1],
    psd_n_seg_ok   = min(c(seg_avail[["Real"]], seg_cap_sim)) >= CFG$psd_n_seg_min,
    acf_n_used     = acf_tbl$n_used[acf_tbl$source == "Real"][1],
    lag1_real = unname(lag1["Real"]),
    lag1_ddpm = unname(lag1["Diffusion"]),
    lag1_gan  = if (has_gan) unname(lag1["GAN"]) else NA_real_,
    gamma = gam
  )

  list(metrics = rows,
       equiv = dplyr::bind_rows(eqd),
       psd = dplyr::mutate(psd, phenotype = ph),
       acf = dplyr::mutate(acf_tbl, phenotype = ph),
       dwell = dplyr::mutate(dw, phenotype = ph),
       env = purrr::imap_dfr(env, function(e, a)
         tibble::tibble(idx = seq_along(e), value = e, source = a, phenotype = ph)),
       traces = traces,
       amp = amp,
       info = info)
}

# Cache key: segment length, equalisation, rates and policy label.
run_one <- function(row, fs, policy) {
  ph  <- row$phenotype
  nps <- NPERSEG_OF[[ph]]
  key <- sprintf("%s_seg%d_%s_%s_%s_%s", ph, nps, LEVEL_OF[[ph]], policy,
                 if (isTRUE(CFG$equalise_noise)) "eq" else "raw",
                 paste(sprintf("%s%g", substr(names(fs), 1, 1), fs), collapse = ""))
  cache_file <- file.path(CFG$out_dir, "cache", paste0(key, ".rds"))
  if (CFG$cache && file.exists(cache_file)) {
    message("Reusing cached ", key)
    return(readRDS(cache_file))
  }
  message("Analysing ", ph, " (", policy, " rates)")
  res <- analyse_one(row, recs[[ph]], fs, LEVEL_OF[[ph]], nps)
  if (CFG$cache) saveRDS(res, cache_file)
  res
}

results <- purrr::map(seq_len(nrow(manifest)), function(i) {
  row <- manifest[i, ]
  run_one(row, FS_MAIN[[row$phenotype]], CFG$rate_policy)
})
names(results) <- manifest$phenotype

pull_all <- function(what) purrr::map_dfr(results, what)

metrics <- pull_all("metrics")
info    <- pull_all("info")

# Stop on any non-finite metric; an NA would drop a phenotype from the paired
# comparison.
bad <- dplyr::filter(metrics, !is.finite(value))
if (nrow(bad)) {
  stop("Non-finite metrics:\n",
       paste(sprintf("  %s / %s / %s", bad$phenotype, bad$method, bad$metric),
             collapse = "\n"))
}
```

# Scoring

Score: the distance itself, 1 - p for the permutation p, and |arm - real| for
summary statistics such as the noise SD. Lower is better for all.

```{r score}
refs <- metrics |>
  dplyr::filter(direction == "reference", method == "Real") |>
  dplyr::select(phenotype, metric, ref = value)

scored <- metrics |>
  dplyr::filter(direction %in% c("lower", "higher", "match_real")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(refs, by = c("phenotype", "metric")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    score = dplyr::case_when(
      direction == "match_real" ~ abs(value - ref),
      direction == "higher"     ~ 1 - value,
      TRUE                      ~ value
    ),
    better = "lower"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(score))


nice_kable(
  scored |> dplyr::arrange(metric, method, phenotype) |>
    dplyr::select(metric, method, phenotype, value, ref, score),
  digits = 5, caption = "Raw values and the comparable score derived from them."
)
readr::write_csv(scored, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "scores_long.csv"))
```

## Head to head, per phenotype

```{r head-to-head}
head_to_head <- scored |>
  dplyr::select(metric, phenotype, method, value) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = value) |>
  dplyr::left_join(refs, by = c("phenotype", "metric")) |>
  dplyr::rename(`Reference (real)` = ref) |>
  dplyr::arrange(metric, phenotype)

nice_kable(head_to_head, digits = 5,
             caption = paste("Similarity metrics for both methods per phenotype,",
                             "with the real reference value."))
readr::write_csv(head_to_head, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "head_to_head_metrics.csv"))
```

# Pooled comparison

Paired design: both methods use the same seed record, so the comparison is on
within-phenotype differences.

```{r paired}
pairable <- scored |>
  dplyr::filter(method %in% c("Diffusion", "GAN")) |>
  dplyr::group_by(metric, phenotype) |>
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(method) == 2) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

n_ph <- dplyr::n_distinct(pairable$phenotype)

# Figure: the eleven similarity metrics only. Equivalence and TOST p-values are
# pooled below but not drawn.

                                score, group = phenotype)) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = method), size = 2.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
```

Each line joins the two scores for one phenotype.

```{r pooled-summary}
wide <- pairable |>
  dplyr::select(metric, phenotype, better, method, score) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = score) |>
  dplyr::mutate(diff = Diffusion - GAN)

paired_stats <- wide |>
  dplyr::group_by(metric, better) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n              = dplyr::n(),
    n_ties         = sum(diff == 0),
    median_diff    = median(diff),
    mean_diff      = mean(diff),
    sd_diff        = sd(diff),
    n_favour_diff  = sum(if (dplyr::first(better) == "lower") diff < 0 else diff > 0),
    p_paired_t     = if (dplyr::n() > 2 && sd(diff) > 0)
                       stats::t.test(diff)$p.value else NA_real_,
    ci_lo          = if (dplyr::n() > 2 && sd(diff) > 0)
                       stats::t.test(diff)$conf.int[1] else NA_real_,
    ci_hi          = if (dplyr::n() > 2 && sd(diff) > 0)
                       stats::t.test(diff)$conf.int[2] else NA_real_,
    # Sign test in the same tail as `better`; exact ties excluded.
    p_sign         = {
      fav <- if (dplyr::first(better) == "lower") sum(diff < 0) else sum(diff > 0)
      nz  <- sum(diff != 0)
      if (nz > 0) stats::binom.test(fav, nz)$p.value else NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_eff   = n - n_ties,
    # Unanimity from the counts (the verdict string may carry " (n tied)").
    unanimous = n_eff > 0 & (n_favour_diff == n_eff | n_favour_diff == 0),
    verdict = dplyr::case_when(
      n_eff == 0             ~ "no separation: all differences exactly tied",
      n_favour_diff == n_eff ~ "consistent: Diffusion",
      n_favour_diff == 0     ~ "consistent: GAN",
      TRUE                   ~ "inconsistent across phenotypes"),
    verdict = dplyr::if_else(n_ties > 0 & n_eff > 0,
                             paste0(verdict, " (", n_ties, " tied)"), verdict)) |>
  dplyr::select(metric, better, n, n_ties, median_diff, mean_diff, sd_diff,
                n_favour_diff, p_paired_t, ci_lo, ci_hi, p_sign, unanimous,
                verdict)

nice_kable(paired_stats, digits = 5,
             caption = paste("Pooled paired comparison, Diffusion minus",
                             "GAN within each phenotype: paired t-test on the",
                             "differences and sign test excluding exact ties."))
readr::write_csv(paired_stats, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "paired_summary.csv"))
```

```{r power}
cat(sprintf("Phenotypes pooled: %d\n", n_ph))

if (min_p_sign > 0.05) {
  cat("\nAbove 0.05: no sign or Wilcoxon signed-rank test can reach p < 0.05 at this n.\n",
      sep = "")
} else {

}

            sum(paired_stats$unanimous), nrow(paired_stats)))

if (any(paired_stats$n_ties > 0)) {
  cat("Metrics with exact ties (excluded from the unanimity count): ",
      paste(paired_stats$metric[paired_stats$n_ties > 0], collapse = ", "),
```

## Bursts

```{r bursts, fig.height = 6}
# Two-component exponential mixture on the closed times by EM, then the
# Colquhoun-Sakmann equal-areas tcrit: the gap length at which as many brief
# closures are misread as between-burst as long ones are misread as within.
fit_tcrit <- function(closed_ms, n_iter = 200) {
  x <- closed_ms[is.finite(closed_ms) & closed_ms > 0]
  if (length(x) < 50) return(NA_real_)
  tau <- stats::quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.9), names = FALSE)
  if (!(tau[2] > tau[1])) return(NA_real_)
  a <- c(0.5, 0.5)
  for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
    d1 <- a[1] * stats::dexp(x, 1 / tau[1])
    d2 <- a[2] * stats::dexp(x, 1 / tau[2])
    w  <- d1 / (d1 + d2); w[!is.finite(w)] <- 0.5
    a   <- c(mean(w), 1 - mean(w))
    tau <- c(sum(w * x) / sum(w), sum((1 - w) * x) / sum(1 - w))
    if (any(!is.finite(tau)) || any(tau <= 0)) return(NA_real_)
  }
  o <- order(tau); tau <- tau[o]; a <- a[o]
  # One closed component: no bursts, no tcrit.
  if (tau[2] / tau[1] < 3 || min(a) < 0.02) return(NA_real_)
  f <- function(t) a[1] * exp(-t / tau[1]) - a[2] * (1 - exp(-t / tau[2]))
  lo <- tau[1] * 1e-3; hi <- tau[2]
  if (!is.finite(f(lo)) || !is.finite(f(hi)) || f(lo) * f(hi) > 0) return(NA_real_)
  stats::uniroot(f, c(lo, hi), tol = 1e-9)$root
}

burst_of <- function(dw, tcrit) {
  if (!is.finite(tcrit)) return(NULL)
  sep <- dw$state == "Closed" & dw$dwell_ms >= tcrit
  b   <- cumsum(sep)
  d <- dw[!sep, , drop = FALSE]; b <- b[!sep]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
  # First and last bursts are truncated by the record ends; dropped.
  inner <- b > min(b) & b < max(b)
  d <- d[inner, , drop = FALSE]; b <- b[inner]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
  tibble::tibble(burst = b, state = d$state, ms = d$dwell_ms) |>
    dplyr::group_by(burst) |>
    dplyr::summarise(length_ms = sum(ms),
                     n_open    = sum(state == "Open"),
                     open_ms   = sum(ms[state == "Open"]),
                     n_gap     = sum(state == "Closed"),
                     gap_ms    = sum(ms[state == "Closed"]),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(n_open > 0)
}

res_burst <- purrr::map(manifest$phenotype, function(ph) {
  arms <- recs[[ph]]; fs <- FS_MAIN[[ph]]
  dwl <- lapply(names(arms), function(a) dwell_times(arms[[a]]$channels, fs[[a]]))
  names(dwl) <- names(arms)
  # One tcrit per phenotype, from the real record, applied to every arm.
  tcrit <- fit_tcrit(dwl$Real$dwell_ms[dwl$Real$state == "Closed"])
  per_burst <- purrr::map_dfr(names(arms), function(a) {
    b <- burst_of(dwl[[a]], tcrit)
    if (is.null(b) || !nrow(b)) return(NULL)
    dplyr::mutate(b, phenotype = ph, source = a)
  })
  if (!nrow(per_burst)) return(list(summary = NULL, per_burst = NULL))
  list(
    per_burst = per_burst,
    summary = per_burst |>
      dplyr::group_by(phenotype, source) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        tcrit_ms = tcrit, n_bursts = dplyr::n(),
        `Burst length (ms)`       = mean(length_ms),
        `Openings per burst`      = mean(n_open),
        `Open time in burst (ms)` = sum(open_ms) / sum(n_open),
        `Gap in burst (ms)`       = if (sum(n_gap)) sum(gap_ms) / sum(n_gap) else NA_real_,
        `Burst Popen`             = sum(open_ms) / sum(length_ms),
        .groups = "drop") |>
      dplyr::mutate(`Bursts per s` = purrr::map_dbl(source, function(a)
        sum(per_burst$source == a) / (nrow(arms[[a]]) / fs[[a]]))))
})

burst      <- purrr::map_dfr(res_burst, "summary")
bursts_raw <- purrr::map_dfr(res_burst, "per_burst")
```

## Label self-consistency

Each arm's current is idealised on its own with a half-amplitude criterion and
compared with that arm's `Channels` column. For the GAN this checks its labels
against its own current; for the diffusion arm, whether the current followed
the conditioning. The real record gives the floor (expert idealisation against
half-amplitude).

```{r self-consistency}
res_selfcon <- purrr::map(manifest$phenotype, function(ph) {

  arms <- recs[[ph]]
  fs   <- FS_MAIN[[ph]]

  # First pass: try unsupervised EM on every arm.
  em_rec <- purrr::map(names(arms), function(a) {

    d <- arms[[a]]

    n_lev <- max(
      1,
      max(d$channels, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

    idealise_half_amplitude(
      d$current,
      n_levels = n_lev,
      polarity = POL_MAIN[[ph]]
    )
  })

  names(em_rec) <- names(arms)

  # If EM fails for any arm, use label-anchored CV for every
  # arm in this phenotype, keeping the comparison consistent.
  em_failed <- vapply(
    em_rec,
    function(x) all(is.na(x)),
    logical(1)
  )

  phenotype_fallback <- any(em_failed)

  if (phenotype_fallback) {
    failed_arms <- names(arms)[em_failed]

    method_note <- paste0(
      "Phenotype-wide fallback because unsupervised EM failed for: ",
      paste(failed_arms, collapse = ", ")
    )
  } else {
    method_note <- ""
  }

  # Second pass: calculate self-consistency using the method
  # selected for this entire phenotype.
  out <- purrr::map(names(arms), function(a) {

    d <- arms[[a]]

    n_lev <- max(
      1,
      max(d$channels, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

    lab <- d$channels > 0

    if (phenotype_fallback) {

      rec <- idealise_label_anchored_cv(
        current = d$current,
        labels = d$channels,
        n_levels = n_lev,
        polarity = POL_MAIN[[ph]],
        block_len = 1000L,
        trim = 0.10,
        min_state_n = 50L
      )

      ideal_method <- "Phenotype-wide label-anchored CV fallback"

    } else {

      rec <- em_rec[[a]]
      ideal_method <- "Unsupervised EM"
    }

    # This occurs only if the selected phenotype-wide
    # method still fails for this arm.
    if (all(is.na(rec))) {

      failure_reason <- attr(rec, "why")

      if (is.null(failure_reason)) {
        failure_reason <- "no reason was recorded"
      }

      return(list(
        summary = tibble::tibble(
          phenotype = ph,
          source = a,
          kappa = NA_real_,
          f1_open = NA_real_,
          popen_labels = mean(lab),
          popen_recovered = NA_real_,
          open_ms_labels = NA_real_,
          open_ms_recovered = NA_real_,
          flicker = NA,
          ideal_method = ideal_method,
          note = paste(
            method_note,
            "Selected method failed:",
            failure_reason
          )
        ),
        dwell = NULL
      ))
    }

    op <- rec > 0

    tp <- sum(lab & op)
    fp <- sum(!lab & op)
    fn <- sum(lab & !op)

    dl <- dwell_times(
      as.integer(lab),
      fs[[a]]
    )

    dr <- dwell_times(
      as.integer(op),
      fs[[a]]
    )

    mo <- function(x) {

      v <- x$dwell_ms[x$state == "Open"]

      if (length(v)) {
        mean(v)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    }

    list(
      summary = tibble::tibble(
        phenotype = ph,
        source = a,
        kappa = cohen_kappa(lab, op),
        f1_open = if (2 * tp + fp + fn > 0) {
          2 * tp / (2 * tp + fp + fn)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        },
        popen_labels = mean(lab),
        popen_recovered = mean(op),
        open_ms_labels = mo(dl),
        open_ms_recovered = mo(dr),
        flicker = length(rle(op)$lengths) > 0.5 * length(op),
        ideal_method = ideal_method,
        note = method_note
      ),

      dwell = dplyr::bind_rows(
        dplyr::mutate(
          dl,
          origin = "Own labels"
        ),
        dplyr::mutate(
          dr,
          origin = "Recovered from current"
        )
      ) |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          phenotype = ph,
          source = a
        )
    )
  })

  list(
    summary = purrr::map_dfr(out, "summary"),
    dwell   = purrr::map_dfr(out, "dwell")
  )
})

self_consist <- purrr::map_dfr(res_selfcon, "summary")
sc_dwell     <- purrr::map_dfr(res_selfcon, "dwell")

if (any(self_consist$flicker %in% TRUE)) {
  warning("The recovered idealisation switches on more than half the samples ",
          "in: ", paste(sprintf("%s/%s", self_consist$phenotype[self_consist$flicker %in% TRUE],
                                self_consist$source[self_consist$flicker %in% TRUE]),
                        collapse = ", "),
          ". Probably a wrong level estimate; kappa unreliable for these rows.")
}

# Recovered Popen ~ 1 - labelled Popen with negative kappa: inverted
# idealisation.
inverted <- self_consist |>
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(kappa),
                abs(popen_recovered - (1 - popen_labels)) < 0.05,
                kappa < 0)
if (nrow(inverted)) {
  warning("The idealisation looks inverted in: ",
          paste(sprintf("%s/%s", inverted$phenotype, inverted$source),
                collapse = ", "), ". Check POL_MAIN for those phenotypes.")
}

nice_kable(self_consist, digits = 4, label = "self_consistency",
             caption = paste("Label self-consistency: each arm's",
                             "Channels column against a half-amplitude",
                             "idealisation of its own current."))
```

```{r self-consistency-deficit-table}
sc_cmp <- self_consist |>
  dplyr::select(phenotype, source, kappa) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = kappa) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(Real),
    is.finite(Diffusion),
    is.finite(GAN)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
  deficit_diffusion = Real - Diffusion,
  deficit_gan       = Real - GAN,

  error_diffusion = abs(Diffusion - Real),
  error_gan       = abs(GAN - Real),

  pct_error_diffusion = 100 * error_diffusion / abs(Real),
  pct_error_gan       = 100 * error_gan / abs(Real),

  favours = dplyr::case_when(
    error_diffusion < error_gan ~ "Diffusion",
    error_gan < error_diffusion ~ "GAN",
    TRUE                        ~ "Tie"
  )
)

nice_kable(sc_cmp, digits = 4, label = "self_consistency_deficit",
             caption = paste("Kappa deficit of each arm against the real",
                             "record's kappa, with absolute and percentage error."))

cat(sprintf("\nPhenotypes where the diffusion arm is the more self-consistent: %d of %d.\n",
            sum(sc_cmp$favours == "Diffusion"), nrow(sc_cmp)))

readr::write_csv(self_consist, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "self_consistency.csv"))
readr::write_csv(sc_cmp, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "self_consistency_comparison.csv"))
```

## Dwell time constants

Exponential time constants fitted to the two dwell sets from the
self-consistency step: the arm's own labels (for the diffusion arm, the
conditioning ground truth) and the half-amplitude idealisation of its current.
The difference between them is the missed-event loss.

One component is reported where two could not be supported; the mean dwell is
then the summary for that row. Closed dwells averaging three or four samples
leave no exponential structure to resolve.

```{r dwell-tau}
tau_fits <- sc_dwell |>
  dplyr::group_by(phenotype, source, state, origin) |>
  dplyr::group_modify(~ fit_exp_mixture(.x$dwell_ms)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(origin = dplyr::recode(origin,
                  `Own labels` = "true",
                  `Recovered from current` = "recovered"))

nice_kable(tau_fits, digits = 4,
           caption = paste("Dwell time constants. 'true' is the arm's own",
                           "label column (for the diffusion arm, the",
                           "conditioning ground truth); 'recovered' is the",
                           "idealisation of that arm's current.",
                           "n_components is 1 where a two-component fit could",
                           "not be supported."))

readr::write_csv(tau_fits, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "dwell_tau_fits.csv"))

cat(sprintf(
  "\nTwo-component fits supportable in %d of %d phenotype/state/origin cells.\n",
  sum(tau_fits$n_components == 2), nrow(tau_fits)))
```

```{r fig-manifold, eval = CFG$do_manifold, fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 12}
if (!all(vapply(c("uwot", "Rtsne"), requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE))) {

proj <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(manifest)), function(i) {
  row <- manifest[i, ]
  d <- list(Real = read_record(row$raw), Diffusion = read_record(row$ddpm))
  if (!is.na(row$gan)) d$GAN <- read_record(row$gan)
  Wp <- lapply(d, function(x) make_windows(x$current, CFG$proj_win, CFG$n_windows_proj))
  X <- do.call(rbind, Wp)
  lab <- rep(names(Wp), vapply(Wp, nrow, integer(1)))
  X <- scale(X); X[!is.finite(X)] <- 0
  um <- uwot::umap(X, n_neighbors = 15, min_dist = 0.1, n_components = 2)
  ts <- Rtsne::Rtsne(X, dims = 2, perplexity = 30, check_duplicates = FALSE,

  dplyr::bind_rows(

    tibble::tibble(x = ts[, 1], y = ts[, 2], source = lab, method = "t-SNE")
  ) |> dplyr::mutate(phenotype = row$phenotype)
})
```

## Cluster separation of the projections

Permutation test (ClusterSignificance, as used for DeepGANnel) of whether the
real and synthetic point clouds are separable in each embedding. A large p means
they are not separable. Run within each phenotype and projection method.

```{r cluster-test, eval = CFG$do_manifold && isTRUE(CFG$do_cluster_test)}
if (!requireNamespace("ClusterSignificance", quietly = TRUE)) {
  message("ClusterSignificance is not installed (Bioconductor):\n",
          '  BiocManager::install("ClusterSignificance")')
  cluster_tbl <- NULL
} else {
  # pcp() takes a two-column matrix and a grouping factor and returns a
  # p-value for every pairwise group comparison, so one call per phenotype
  # per method covers both Real-vs-Diffusion and Real-vs-GAN.
  cluster_one <- function(d) {
    mat <- as.matrix(d[, c("x", "y")])
    grp <- factor(as.character(d$source))
    if (dplyr::n_distinct(grp) < 2 || nrow(mat) < 10) return(NULL)
    pe <- ClusterSignificance::permute(
      mat = mat, classes = as.character(grp), iter = CFG$n_perm_cluster,
      projmethod = "pcp")
    p <- ClusterSignificance::pvalue(pe)
    tibble::tibble(comparison = names(p), p = as.numeric(p))
  }

  cluster_tbl <- proj |>
    dplyr::group_by(phenotype, method) |>
    dplyr::group_modify(~ {
      r <- tryCatch(cluster_one(.x),
                    error = function(e)
                      tibble::tibble(comparison = "failed",
                                     p = NA_real_,
                                     note = conditionMessage(e)))
      if (is.null(r)) tibble::tibble(comparison = NA_character_, p = NA_real_) else r
    }) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  nice_kable(cluster_tbl, digits = 4,
             caption = paste("ClusterSignificance permutation p-values for",
                             "separation between the point clouds in each",
                             "embedding."))

  readr::write_csv(cluster_tbl,
                   file.path(CFG$out_dir, "cluster_significance.csv"))

  if (any(is.na(cluster_tbl$p)))
    warning("Some cluster tests returned no p-value; see the note column.")
}
```

## Figure: generation block joins

Long diffusion records are built from overlapping blocks joined by context-carry
inpainting. Sample-to-sample differences near each join are compared with those
within blocks.

Only the diffusion arm has joins (the GAN emits its record in one pass), so this
is a single-arm check. It runs on the uncropped diffusion arm, since cropping
would move the joins.

```{r fig-seams, fig.height = 7}
step <- CFG$block_len - CFG$context_len
half <- CFG$context_len %/% 2

# Joins of one record, dropping any that fall within half a context length of
# either end, where there is not enough material on both sides to compare.
joins_of <- function(n) {
  # seq() errors when the record is shorter than one block.
  if (n <= step) return(numeric(0))
  b <- seq(step, n - 1L, by = step)
  b[b > CFG$context_len & b < (n - CFG$context_len)]
}

seam_one <- function(d, ph) {
  n <- nrow(d)
  b <- joins_of(n)
  diffs <- diff(d$current)

  if (!length(b)) {
    return(list(
      summary = tibble::tibble(phenotype = ph, n_samples = n, n_joins = 0L,
                               ks_seam = NA_real_, p_seam = NA_real_,
                               note = "single block, no joins to test"),
      trace = NULL, joins = numeric(0)))
  }

  near <- unique(unlist(lapply(b, function(i) seq(i - half, i + half))))
  near <- near[near >= 1 & near <= length(diffs)]
  far  <- setdiff(seq_along(diffs), near)

  ks <- ks_safe(diffs[near], diffs[far])

  # Drawing only: the first CFG$long_record_secs, decimated. The KS test uses
  # every sample and every join.
  fs_d   <- 1 / stats::median(diff(d$time[seq_len(min(n, 1000L))]))
  n_show <- min(n, as.integer(round(CFG$long_record_secs * fs_d)))
  dec  <- max(1L, n_show %/% 20000L)
  keep <- seq(1L, n_show, by = dec)

  list(
    summary = tibble::tibble(
      phenotype = ph, n_samples = n, n_joins = length(b),
      ks_seam = unname(ks$statistic), p_seam = unname(ks$p.value),
      note = sprintf("%d samples near a join, %d within blocks",
                     length(near), length(far))),
    trace = tibble::tibble(phenotype = ph, time_s = d$time[keep],
                           current = d$current[keep]),
    joins = d$time[b[b <= n_show]])
}

res_seam <- purrr::imap(recs_full_diffusion, function(d, ph) seam_one(d, ph))

seam_tbl   <- purrr::map_dfr(res_seam, "summary")
seam_trace <- purrr::map_dfr(res_seam, "trace")
seam_lines <- purrr::imap_dfr(res_seam, function(r, ph)
  if (length(r$joins)) tibble::tibble(phenotype = ph, time_s = r$joins) else NULL)

nice_kable(seam_tbl, digits = 4,
           caption = paste("Block joins in the diffusion arm. ks_seam compares",
                           "sample-to-sample differences within half a carried",
                           "context of a join with those within blocks."))

readr::write_csv(seam_tbl, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "seam_test.csv"))
```

# Summary values

Summary values for results_values.csv. Pooled values are medians across
phenotypes, with the range.

```{r placeholders}
fmt <- function(x, d = 4) formatC(x, digits = d, format = "g")

pooled <- scored |>
  dplyr::group_by(metric, method) |>
  dplyr::summarise(median = median(value), lo = min(value), hi = max(value),
                   .groups = "drop")

placeholders <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(placeholder = "n_phenotypes", value = as.character(n_ph),
                 note = "paired seed records"),
  # Total seed samples, and the subset scored after cropping each phenotype to
  # its shortest arm.
  tibble::tibble(placeholder = "n_samples_total",
                 value = format(sum(seed_inventory$n_rows), big.mark = ","),
                 note = "seed samples across all phenotypes, before cropping"),
  tibble::tibble(placeholder = "n_samples_analysed",
                 value = format(sum(info$n_real), big.mark = ","),
                 note = "seed samples actually scored, after cropping each phenotype to its shortest arm"),
  # Round before unique() so floating-point error does not split one rate.
  tibble::tibble(placeholder = "sample_khz",
                 value = paste(unique(round(sort(info$fs_real) / 1000, 3)),
                               collapse = ", "),
                 note = "acquisition rate(s), kHz"),
  pooled |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      placeholder = paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", tolower(metric)), "_",
                           tolower(method)),
      value = sprintf("%s (%s to %s)", fmt(median), fmt(lo), fmt(hi)),
      note = paste("median across phenotypes, range in brackets")),
  paired_stats |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      placeholder = paste0("unanimity_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", tolower(metric))),
      value = sprintf("%d/%d favour Diffusion", n_favour_diff, n),
      note = verdict),
  # Diffusion-arm dwell time constants (true and recovered), listed per
  # phenotype, where a two-component fit held.
  {
    tf <- tau_fits |>
      dplyr::filter(source == "Diffusion", n_components == 2L)
    if (nrow(tf)) {
      tf |>
        dplyr::mutate(ph = gsub("^Phenotype_", "", phenotype)) |>
        dplyr::group_by(state, origin) |>
        dplyr::summarise(
          value = paste(sprintf("%s %.3g/%.3g", ph, tau_fast_ms, tau_slow_ms),
                        collapse = ", "),
          n_ph = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
        dplyr::transmute(
          placeholder = sprintf("tau_%s_%s", tolower(state), origin),
          value = value,
          note = sprintf("fast/slow tau in ms, per phenotype, %d of %d phenotypes supported two components",
                         n_ph, dplyr::n_distinct(tau_fits$phenotype)))
    } else {
      tibble::tibble(placeholder = "tau_fits", value = "NOT SUPPORTED",
                     note = "no phenotype supported a two-component dwell fit")
    }
  },
  # Cluster separation, if the optional test ran.
  {
    if (exists("cluster_tbl") && !is.null(cluster_tbl) &&
        any(is.finite(cluster_tbl$p))) {
      cp <- dplyr::filter(cluster_tbl, is.finite(p))
      tibble::tibble(
        placeholder = "cluster_p",
        value = sprintf("%s (%s to %s)", fmt(median(cp$p)),
                        fmt(min(cp$p)), fmt(max(cp$p))),
        note = sprintf("ClusterSignificance permutation p, median over %d tests; large p means not separable",
                       nrow(cp)))
    } else {
      tibble::tibble(placeholder = "cluster_p", value = "NOT RUN",
                     note = "ClusterSignificance absent or the test failed")
    }
  },
  # Seam test: median and range over phenotypes with at least one join.
  {
    s <- dplyr::filter(seam_tbl, is.finite(ks_seam))
    if (nrow(s))
      tibble::tibble(
        placeholder = "ks_seam",
        value = sprintf("%s (%s to %s)", fmt(median(s$ks_seam)),
                        fmt(min(s$ks_seam)), fmt(max(s$ks_seam))),
        note = sprintf("median across %d phenotypes, %d joins tested in total",
                       nrow(s), sum(s$n_joins)))
    else
      tibble::tibble(placeholder = "ks_seam", value = "NOT RUN",
                     note = "no phenotype spanned more than one block")
  }
)

nice_kable(placeholders, caption = "Summary values written to results_values.csv.")

readr::write_csv(placeholders, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "results_values.csv"))
```
